tz.help: This field is used in order to define in which timezone the resources will work.

activity_state.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.

activity_exception_decoration.help: Type of the exception activity on record.

activity_exception_icon.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.

message_needaction.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.

message_has_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_has_error_counter.help: Number of messages with delivery error

message_has_sms_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

hr_responsible_id.help: Person responsible for validating the employee's contracts.

user_id.help: Related user name for the resource to manage its access.

share.help: External user with limited access, created only for the purpose of sharing data.

active.help: If the active field is set to False, it will allow you to hide the resource record without removing it.

company_country_code.help:
The ISO country code in two chars. 
You can use this field for quick search.

legal_name.help: The employee's official name as per government-issued or legal documents.

bank_account_ids.help: Employee bank accounts to pay salaries

first_contract_date.help: The date of the first contract of the employee in the company.

contract_date_end.help: End date of the contract (if it's a fixed-term contract).

trial_date_end.help: End date of the trial period (if there is one).

nationality_country_code.help:
The ISO country code in two chars. 
You can use this field for quick search.

coach_id.help:
Select the "Employee" who is the coach of this employee.
The "Coach" has no specific rights or responsibilities by default.

pin.help: PIN used to Check In/Out in the Kiosk Mode of the Attendance application (if enabled in Configuration) and to change the cashier in the Point of Sale application.

dismissal_date.help: Date at which the departure process starts. Differs from the actual departure date in case of a notice period.

departure_date.help: Date at which the departure actually takes place.

departure_action_date.help: Date at which the departure actually takes place.

exceptional_location_id.help: This is the exceptional, non-weekly, location set for today.

badge_ids.help: All employee badges, linked to the employee either directly or through the user

direct_badge_ids.help: Badges directly linked to the employee

default_planning_role_id.help:
Role that will be selected by default when creating a shift for this employee.
This role will also have precedence over the other roles of the employee when planning orders.

planning_role_ids.help:
Roles that the employee can fill in. When creating a shift for this employee, only the shift templates for these roles will be displayed.
Similarly, only the open shifts available for these roles will be sent to the employee when the schedule is published.
Additionally, the employee will only be assigned orders for these roles (with the default planning role having precedence over the other ones).
Leave empty for the employee to be assigned shifts regardless of the role.

identification_id.help: Enter the employee's National Identification Number issued by the government (e.g., Aadhaar, SIN, NIN). This is used for official records and statutory compliance.

sex.help: This is the legal sex as recognized by the state, used for official and statutory purposes.

member_of_department.help: Whether the employee is a member of the active user's department or one of it's child department.

active_employee.help: If the active field is set to False, it will allow you to hide the resource record without removing it.

country_code.help:
The ISO country code in two chars. 
You can use this field for quick search.
